What Is It?
AI Document Manager is IONOS's new AI-native product that turns a small business's accumulated documents into a searchable, queryable knowledge base — automatically. It captures, organises, and understands every business document from the moment it arrives, then lets users ask questions, extract data — without ever digging through a folder. Generation of briefs and other outputs is planned for a future phase.
In short: it replaces three tools — cloud storage, document scanner, and AI search assistant — with one product (AI-generated outputs, such as briefs and slide decks, are coming in a later phase) running entirely on EU infrastructure.

The Problem We Are Solving
European small businesses are drowning in documents they cannot use. Invoices, contracts, delivery notes, scans, and email attachments accumulate across phones, inboxes, and hard drives — and become invisible the moment they are stored.

55% of European SMBs spend over 40% of their working time on administration
"I know we have it, but I cannot find it" — followed by 30 minutes of searching — is the default experience
Existing storage tools (Dropbox, OneDrive) require users to name files, build folders, and remember where things went
Existing AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT) require users to manually curate a corpus before they work
No competitor in the EU market closes the loop from document intake to actionable insight in a single product

Who We Are Selling To
Primary audience: European SMBs with 1–10 employees in service-oriented industries. The three segments below account for the largest addressable base by document volume.

Trades & Property Services

Cleaning firms, construction, landscaping, roofing, facility management. High daily volume of inbound paperwork: supplier invoices, delivery notes, subcontractor agreements, site photos.
Business consulting, IT services, HR, coaching, energy consulting. Accumulates years of client proposals, contracts, meeting notes, and deliverables. Needs to retrieve and reuse past work instantly.
Agents, property managers, holiday rental operators. High-volume documents tied to long-lived assets: rental contracts, handover protocols, tenant correspondence, regulatory filings.


Buyer Personas

Solo Service Provider
Tradesperson, cleaner, photographer, freelancer
Pain: Documents pile up on the phone, in the van, in unread emails. No time or system to file anything.
Needs: One-tap mobile capture, automatic classification, instant retrieval — no folder structure required. Price-sensitive, mobile-first.


Small Business Owner-Operator
Consulting, IT, real estate, property management
Pain: Years of client documents across multiple drives, inboxes, and folders. 30-minute searches are the norm.
Needs: Conversational access to the whole library, structured data extraction, AI-summarised answers before meetings.


Office Administrator
Back-office for trades, professional services, or SMB teams
Pain: Is the human search engine of the company — constantly asked "where is X?" or "what did we agree with Y?"
Needs: The system takes over: structured organisation by client and project, proactive deadline alerts, automatic invoice data extraction.


Value Proposition & Key Customer Benefits
One product. Three things customers currently pay separate tools for today — with a fourth on the roadmap.
📥 Capture
Documents arrive through any launch channel — web upload, desktop sync, or mobile capture. Nothing needs to be filed manually.
🗂️ Organise
AI automatically classifies 134 document types (across 9 domains), extracts key fields, links entities across files, and routes everything into the right entity view.
💬 Ask
Users ask questions in plain language. Answers come back with cited sources — specific document and page. Cross-document reasoning spans hundreds of files at once.


Five Benefits That Matter to Customers
Find any document or piece of information in seconds — not 30-minute search sessions
Ask "What did I agree with Mayer GmbH in March?" and get the answer with a link to the exact contract page
Never lose a document again — every file is automatically named, classified, and searchable from day one
Photos captured via the mobile app are named, classified, and searchable instantly; files added via web upload or desktop sync are stored and organised the same way, with no manual filing
Know what you owe and when — contractual deadlines and renewal dates are surfaced automatically across all stored documents
Notice periods, rent reviews, payment terms — extracted and tracked without any manual input
Get up to speed on any client in minutes — ask IONOS GPT to summarise everything in an entity view
Proposals, contracts, correspondence, notes — summarised conversationally, on demand, through Q&A
Full GDPR compliance out of the box — all AI processing runs on EU infrastructure, DPA is automatic, no US data transfers

Positioning Line
"The fastest path from paperwork to decision — handled by AI."

The product is positioned within the IONOS Momentum KI suite — meaning sales conversations can upsell to AI CRM, AI Contract Manager, and AI Knowledge Hub. The AI Document Manager is both a standalone product and a natural entry point into the broader suite.

description: Deploy Now ist die neue Webhosting-Innovation von IONOS für professionelle Web-Entwickler, die sicheres Hosting mit der Flexibilität einer direkten GitHub-Entwicklungsumgebung kombiniert.
briefing:
Elevator Pitch: Deploy Now ist die neueste Produktinnovation von IONOS im Bereich Webhosting. Die Zielgruppe sind Entwickler, die professionell Websites erstellen. Deploy Now kombiniert sicheres Hosting mit der Flexibilität einer Git-Entwicklungsumgebung. Mit Deploy Now können Developer ihre Webprojekte direkt von ihren GitHub-Accounts launchen. Dies spart Zeit und ermöglicht, Hosting nahtlos in Workflows einzubinden. Das Einrichten von Deploy Now ist dank eines dev-freundlichen, übersichtlichen Interfaces besonders einfach und schnell erledigt. Deploy Now funktioniert mit allen gängigen Frontend Frameworks und Static-Website-Generatoren.
Localization Strategy: Alle IONOS Märkte, wobei DE, US und UK im Fokus sind. Das Produkt ist nur in englischer Sprache erhältlich und wird nicht lokalisiert, das Marketing und die Werbemittel hingegen schon.
GitHub Integration: Deploy Now ermöglicht Entwicklern, ihre Websites und Web-Projekte auf einer sicheren, redundanten Hosting-Infrastruktur zu veröffentlichen, ohne dabei die GitHub-Umgebung verlassen zu müssen.
Repository Workflow: Nachdem sie das Produkt installiert haben, können sie direkt von ihrem Repository aus arbeiten, inklusive Feature Branches, Testings, Staging und dem bequemen Deployen von Updates in ihrer vertrauten Dev-Umgebung.
CI/CD Integration: Deploy Now und GitHub zusammen zu benutzen, eliminiert Probleme und wasserfallartige Release Models. Das bedeutet, dass Entwickler das Produkt mit modernen CI/CD-Pipelines integrieren können.
Decoupled Architecture: Die Nutzung von Deploy Now kann außerdem monolithische Web-Architekturen vermeiden, indem statische Website-Generatoren in flexiblen, entkoppelten Architekturen genutzt werden können.
